Resolves #21586
Related: #21033

The Home hero now shows the seven complete UTC days before the planned Engine 14 release, 16–22 November 2026. Its 459 squares represent 459 merged pull requests. The caption records 695 reviews and 35 outside contributors.

Evidence: L3 (independent reconciliation of every GitHub PR ID and rendered Home at phone and desktop sizes) → L3 required. The public-site walkthrough follows deployment.

## AC Evidence

| Acceptance | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Window and totals | Seven daily GitHub reads found 473 distinct PRs. Fourteen were authored by GitHub bot accounts. Every remaining ID matched the generated list, and every stored total was independently recomputed. [Independent census](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21586#issuecomment-7092999603). |
| Release sequence | Step 3 of [the release runbook](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21033) names the generator. The inventory, [phone renderer](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/22086) and [Features cards](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/22089) have merged. At `237d1ffac2` the sole difference from `dev` `b027d898e3` is the record JSON. |
| Rendered record | On this tree the production App Worker fetched the exact 62,860-byte record. At 390 × 844 and 1440 × 900 the Canvas Worker drew 459 occupied squares and left all 185 empty positions clear. The phone had a 10 px gap below the buttons; desktop retained twelve seats. |

## Deltas from ticket

The only changed file is the output of `node buildScripts/docs/recordWeek.mjs --to 2026-11-23`. Its complete UTC window runs from 16 November at 00:00 through 23 November at 00:00 exclusive.

## Test Evidence

- On the actual updated branch, the generator and renderer unit suites passed 35/35, and all seven Home browser cases passed with retries disabled.
- The production rehearsal used the same Git tree as this PR, `7eaff968e9203c0f4f63530f98f15b01c778a661`. The package rehearsal also included the byte-identical feed. The previous 301-PR week failed the deployed-readback checker at its date comparison.
- An earlier base left the 390 px strip blank with the denser week. This PR now includes the merged repair through its base, and the 459-record file has the same blob as originally reviewed by the independent census.
